## Structured fields

Schemas for the additional fields and repository links of a project. These fields hold rows validated against a published schema; the form shows them as a table, the API returns them as stored. The fields of each row:

### Additional fields

Any extra parameters you want to add to this project. Saved as key-value pairs. Values can be strings or numbers.

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `key` | Text. |
| `value` | Object. |

### Public repositories

Link to public repositories where data from this project is stored.

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `Repository` | **Required.** Choice. Options: CRCNS, DANDI, Figshare, GitHub, Globus, Mendeley, Zenodo, Webshare, Other. |
| `URL` | **Required.** Text. |

The schemas are published at `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Project/` (see [Public schemas](/api/public-schemas/)); the API view with property codes is on the [Project API page](/api/stem/project/#json-field-schemas).
